name: Teicoplanin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Complicated skin and soft tissue infection, pneumonia, complicated urinary tract infection
usual_adult_dose.dose: Loading 6 mg/kg IV or IM every 12 hours for 3 doses, then 6 mg/kg once daily
Loading 12 mg/kg IV every 12 hours for 3 to 5 doses, then 12 mg/kg once daily
Loading 12 mg/kg IV every 12 hours for 3 to 5 doses, then 12 mg/kg once daily; usually at least 21 days
100 to 200 mg orally twice daily for 7 to 14 days

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Aminoglycosides, colistin, amphotericin B, cyclosporine, cisplatin, loop diuretics (furosemide, ethacrynic acid)
key_interactions.action: Use with care; monitor kidney function and hearing.
Do not mix (compatible in CAPD fluid).

serious: Nephrotoxicity and acute kidney failure (about 2% on standard loading; 11% to 27% with high loading regimens)
Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis, DRESS, acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis

monitoring: Trough levels after loading and at least weekly
Kidney function, especially with high loading doses or nephrotoxic drugs

pk.bioavailability: Not absorbed orally (oral use is for colitis only)
pk.half_life_eskd: Prolonged; clearance tracks creatinine clearance (not quantified)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 80% unchanged in urine over 16 days
pk.dialyzability: Not removed by hemodialysis; slowly by peritoneal dialysis

sources.citation: Sanofi. (2025). Targocid 200 mg and 400 mg powder for solution for injection/infusion or oral solution (teicoplanin) [Summary of product characteristics, English; revised December 11, 2025]. Swedish Medical Products Agency (Läkemedelsverket).
